name: @activepieces/piece-google-cloud-storage
description: Automate file storage operations with Google Cloud Storage. Upload, download, manage buckets, set permissions, and monitor changes with real-time triggers.

create_bucket.name: create_bucket
create_bucket.description: Create a new bucket in a specified location/configuration. Perfect for automating storage provisioning for new projects.

name.description: Unique name for your bucket (must be globally unique, 3-63 characters)

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new Cloud Storage bucket in the given project, with optional location, storage class, versioning, uniform bucket-level access, and labels. Use to provision storage before uploading objects. Not idempotent: bucket names are globally unique, so re-running with the same name fails. Requires a project ID and a globally-unique bucket name.

delete_empty_bucket.name: delete_empty_bucket
delete_empty_bucket.description: Clean up unused buckets by deleting them if they contain no live objects.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a Cloud Storage bucket. Use to clean up an unused bucket. The bucket must be empty (no live or noncurrent objects) or the call fails, so delete its objects first. Not idempotent: the first call removes the bucket and a repeat fails because it no longer exists.

clone_object.name: clone_object
clone_object.description: Copy / clone an object (file) to a new location (same or different bucket), optionally overriding metadata. Perfect for duplicating files as backup or version.

destObject.description: Name for the copied object (must be valid object name)

metadataOverrides.description: Optional metadata and properties to override in the copied object (contentType, cacheControl, contentDisposition, etc.)

aiMetadata.description: Copies an existing object to a destination bucket/name (same or different bucket), optionally overriding metadata such as contentType or cacheControl. Use to duplicate a file for backups or to move data between buckets. Not idempotent: it writes a new destination object on each call, creating a fresh generation. Requires the source bucket/object and a destination bucket and object name.

delete_object.name: delete_object
delete_object.description: Permanently delete a specific object. Perfect for removing obsolete files.

generation.description: Optional generation number for versioned objects (permanently deletes a specific revision)

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes an object from a bucket, optionally a specific generation/revision for versioned objects. Use to remove an obsolete or unwanted file. Not idempotent: the first call removes the object and a repeat fails because it no longer exists. Requires the bucket and object name.

search_objects.name: search_objects
search_objects.description: Search objects by criteria. Perfect for finding files in your bucket.

prefix.description: Filter objects whose names begin with this prefix

includeFoldersAsPrefixes.description: Include empty folders and managed folders in results

versions.description: List all versions of objects as distinct results

maxResults.description: Maximum number of objects to return (recommended: ≤1000)

aiMetadata.description: Lists objects in a bucket, optionally narrowed by name prefix, glob pattern, delimiter (for hierarchical/folder listing), or object versions; with no filters it returns all objects. Use to find files or enumerate bucket contents, and pass the returned page token to paginate. Idempotent read that does not modify storage. Requires the bucket name.

search_buckets.name: search_buckets
search_buckets.description: Search buckets by name. Perfect for finding buckets in your project.

prefix.description: Filter buckets whose names begin with this prefix

includeSoftDeleted.description: Include soft-deleted bucket versions in results

maxResults.description: Maximum number of buckets to return

aiMetadata.description: Lists buckets in a project, optionally filtered by name prefix, including soft-deleted versions, and choosing whether ACLs are returned; with no prefix it returns all buckets. Use to find a bucket or enumerate a project's buckets, and pass the returned page token to paginate. Idempotent read that does not modify storage. Requires the project ID.

create_object_acl.name: create_object_acl
create_object_acl.description: Add an ACL entry to an object (grant a permission). Perfect for granting read/write access to a user or group.

entity.description: The entity to grant access to. Must include the entity type prefix. Format: user-emailAddress, group-groupId, group-emailAddress, domain-domainName, project-team-projectId, allUsers, or allAuthenticatedUsers. Examples: user-liz@example.com, group-mygroup@googlegroups.com, domain-example.com, allUsers

generation.description: Optional generation number for versioned objects

aiMetadata.description: Grants an entity (user, group, domain, or special scope) a role on a single object's access-control list, optionally targeting a specific generation. Use to give read or owner access to one file. Not idempotent: adding an entry that already exists fails. Only works on buckets using fine-grained ACLs, not uniform bucket-level access; requires bucket, object, entity, and role.

delete_object_acl.name: delete_object_acl
delete_object_acl.description: Remove an ACL entry from an object. Perfect for revoking access for a user.

entity.description: The entity to grant access to. Must include the entity type prefix. Format: user-emailAddress, group-groupId, group-emailAddress, domain-domainName, project-team-projectId, allUsers, or allAuthenticatedUsers. Examples: user-liz@example.com, group-mygroup@googlegroups.com, domain-example.com, allUsers

generation.description: Optional generation number for versioned objects

aiMetadata.description: Removes an entity's entry from a single object's access-control list, optionally targeting a specific generation. Use to revoke a user or group's access to one file. Not idempotent: the first call removes the entry and a repeat fails because it no longer exists. Only works on buckets using fine-grained ACLs, not uniform bucket-level access; requires bucket, object, and entity.

create_bucket_acl.name: create_bucket_acl
create_bucket_acl.description: Add an ACL entry at bucket level. Perfect for granting permission to manage the bucket.

entity.description: The entity to grant access to. Must include the entity type prefix. Format: user-emailAddress, group-groupId, group-emailAddress, domain-domainName, project-team-projectId, allUsers, or allAuthenticatedUsers. Examples: user-liz@example.com, group-mygroup@googlegroups.com, domain-example.com, allUsers

aiMetadata.description: Grants an entity (user, group, domain, or special scope) a role on a bucket's own access-control list. Use to let someone read or manage the bucket itself. Not idempotent: adding an entry that already exists fails. Only works on buckets using fine-grained ACLs, not uniform bucket-level access; requires bucket, entity, and role.

delete_bucket_acl.name: delete_bucket_acl
delete_bucket_acl.description: Remove an ACL entry from a bucket. Perfect for revoking access for a user or group.

entity.description: The entity to grant access to. Must include the entity type prefix. Format: user-emailAddress, group-groupId, group-emailAddress, domain-domainName, project-team-projectId, allUsers, or allAuthenticatedUsers. Examples: user-liz@example.com, group-mygroup@googlegroups.com, domain-example.com, allUsers

aiMetadata.description: Removes an entity's entry from a bucket's own access-control list. Use to revoke a user or group's access to the bucket. Not idempotent: the first call removes the entry and a repeat fails because it no longer exists. Only works on buckets using fine-grained ACLs, not uniform bucket-level access; requires bucket and entity.

create_bucket_default_object_acl.name: create_bucket_default_object_acl
create_bucket_default_object_acl.description: Set default ACLs for new objects added to a bucket. Perfect for automatically assigning permissions to new uploads.

entity.description: The entity to grant access to. Must include the entity type prefix. Format: user-emailAddress, group-groupId, group-emailAddress, domain-domainName, project-team-projectId, allUsers, or allAuthenticatedUsers. Examples: user-liz@example.com, group-mygroup@googlegroups.com, domain-example.com, allUsers

aiMetadata.description: Adds an entry to a bucket's default object ACL, which is applied automatically to objects later uploaded without their own ACL. Use to pre-set permissions for future uploads. Not idempotent: adding an entry that already exists fails, and it does not affect existing objects. Only works on buckets using fine-grained ACLs, not uniform bucket-level access; requires bucket, entity, and role.

delete_bucket_default_object_acl.name: delete_bucket_default_object_acl
delete_bucket_default_object_acl.description: Remove default ACL settings from a bucket. Perfect for reverting to default behavior.

entity.description: The entity to grant access to. Must include the entity type prefix. Format: user-emailAddress, group-groupId, group-emailAddress, domain-domainName, project-team-projectId, allUsers, or allAuthenticatedUsers. Examples: user-liz@example.com, group-mygroup@googlegroups.com, domain-example.com, allUsers

aiMetadata.description: Removes an entity's entry from a bucket's default object ACL, so it no longer applies to future uploads. Use to revert a default-permission rule for new objects. Not idempotent: the first call removes the entry and a repeat fails because it no longer exists, and it does not affect already-uploaded objects. Only works on buckets using fine-grained ACLs, not uniform bucket-level access; requires bucket and entity.

new_object_created.name: new_object_created
new_object_created.description: Triggers when a new object is created in a bucket

prefix.description: Only trigger for objects with this prefix

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new object is finalized (fully written) in the configured bucket, optionally limited to objects whose name starts with a given prefix. Represents a newly created/uploaded file; delivered via a Cloud Pub/Sub push notification (OBJECT_FINALIZE event).

object_updated.name: object_updated
object_updated.description: Triggers when an existing object is updated in a bucket

prefix.description: Only trigger for objects with this prefix

aiMetadata.description: Fires when the metadata of an existing object in the configured bucket is updated, optionally limited to objects whose name starts with a given prefix. Represents a change to an existing file's metadata; delivered via a Cloud Pub/Sub push notification (OBJECT_METADATA_UPDATE event).

fr.Delete Bucket Default Object ACL: Supprimer l'objet ACL par défaut du seau

fr.Remove an ACL entry from a bucket. Perfe: Retirer une entrée ACL d'un segment. Parfait pour révoquer l'accès pour un utilisateur ou un groupe.

fr.Name for the copied object (must be vali: Nom de l'objet copié (doit être un nom d'objet valide)
fr.Optional metadata and properties to over: Métadonnées et propriétés optionnelles à remplacer dans l'objet copié (contentType, cacheControl, contentDisposition, etc.)

fr.Glob pattern to filter results (e.g., \": Modèle de Glob pour filtrer les résultats (par exemple, "dossier/*", "backup-*.txt")
fr.Include empty folders and managed folder: Inclure les dossiers vides et les dossiers gérés dans les résultats

fr.Token for pagination (from previous resp: Jeton pour la pagination (à partir de la réponse précédente)
